'''Life Regen Aura''' is a [[monster aura]] version of {{il|Vitality}} gem. The mod would be displayed under the monster nameplate as {{c|mod|Allies Regenerate Life}}. Some implicit monster mods also under the mod type "MonsterAuraLifeRegen" function similar to the 
{{stl|Life Regen Aura}}.

The player character can have this monster aura by stealing it from monster when using {{il|Headhunter}} or {{il|Inspired Learning}}. Players can also use {{il|Conversion Trap}} to convert monster with this aura as a temporary allies. Moreover, maps affected by the legacy [[sextant]] mod {{c|mod|Areas contain # additional packs of Monsters that Convert when Killed}} may spawn enemies with this mod, granting effects of the aura to players when converted.

Lastly, {{c|mod|Life Regen}} is another monster mod. That mod does not affect monster's allies.
